lifecycle.title: Discover & Prototype
lifecycle.activities: Use-case framing, model choice, prompt prototypes
lifecycle.pitch: Turn a fuzzy business problem into a working GenAI proof-of-concept in days, not quarters — rapid prompting, model selection, and a demo stakeholders can click.

lifecycle.title: Retrieve & Ground
lifecycle.outcome: Answers cited to your own data
lifecycle.pitch: Production-grade RAG: ingestion, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, and knowledge graphs — so every answer is grounded and cited, never hallucinated.

lifecycle.title: Orchestrate Agents
lifecycle.pitch: Multi-agent systems with supervisors, specialists, and verifiers — tool calling over MCP, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop by design.

lifecycle.title: Evaluate & Optimize
lifecycle.activities: Golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites, tuning
lifecycle.pitch: If it isn't measured, it isn't shipped. LLM-as-a-judge, golden datasets, regression suites, latency/cost tuning, and fine-tuning when prompting hits its ceiling.

lifecycle.title: Deploy & Scale
lifecycle.activities: CI/CD, containers, serving, monitoring, cost control
lifecycle.pitch: Containerized, CI/CD-driven, cloud-native deployments with streaming APIs, model serving, monitoring, and cost control — LLMOps end to end.

skillGroups.label: Generative AI
skillGroups.blurb: LLM products, RAG and multi-agent systems, designed for real users rather than demos.

skillGroups.label: ML & Deep Learning
skillGroups.blurb: Classic ML and deep learning, from sensor time-series to reinforcement learning.

skillGroups.label: LLMOps & Cloud
skillGroups.blurb: Pipelines, tracking and cloud infrastructure that keep models reliable in production.

skillGroups.label: Engineering
skillGroups.blurb: Solid software engineering: typed code, clean APIs and streaming backends.

skillGroups.label: Physical AI & Embedded
skillGroups.blurb: Robots that learn: VLA policies, simulation, edge inference and the electronics underneath.
